g.text: Query, NL Understanding & Hybrid Retrieval API Stage - Component Architecture
- FastAPI router with trace ID propagation
- Single service behind all user-facing surfaces
- Implements REST endpoints, tools, and CLI
- LLM-based parsing with strict JSON schema
- Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) for result merging
- JSON schemas for LLM function calling
- All reads go through store repositories
- NLU cache in PostgreSQL for query reuse
